message.content:
It looks like there isn’t a dedicated “logout” endpoint exposed through this interface—only a `user_authentication_login` helper is available.  
If you’re looking to start a fresh authenticated session (which would implicitly replace whatever previous session existed), you can simply invoke the login routine:

```python
from functions import user_authentication_login

token_response = user_authentication_login(
    username="your_username",
    password="your_password",
    remember_me=False,
    login_attempts=0,
    # security_token=None   # include if you have 2‑FA set up
)
```

That will return an authentication token which you can store locally. Once you’ve finished using it, you can discard the token on your side (e.g., delete it from memory or local storage).  

If you truly need a server‑side “sign‑out” operation, please let me know what backend service you’re working against—I’ll try to find the appropriate endpoint or workaround.
